renderings.value: I usually cut loose a bit and drink plenty before a day off work, but if my drinks are cut with tochu tea, then I get absolutely no hangover.
"I heard that 70% of Japanese are ninjas. Is it true?" "Where did you hear that from?"
If a Japanese person continues to live day by day without rice, there is a 70% chance their face will look like a corpse's.
Tom can crack an egg with one hand.
Only 30% of the Irish population speaks Irish.
